event_description: Fired when a dreamer authenticates via the test-login endpoint.
Fired when a new dreamer account is created.
Fired when a dreamer's profile is updated.
Fired when a new dreamer group is created.
Fired when a dreamer is added to a group.
Fired when a dreamer completes onboarding by submitting their answers.
Fired when a dreamer requests AI-powered job recommendations via vector search.
Fired when a dreamer performs a keyword search for jobs.
Fired when a dreamer marks a job recommendation as good (interested).
Fired when a dreamer marks a job recommendation as bad (not interested).
Fired when a dreamer saves a job for later review.
Fired when a dreamer starts a new AI chat conversation.
Fired when a dreamer sends a message in an AI chat conversation.
